name: transfer_test
title: K5 transfer test: cross-substrate onset detection (annotation sidestep)
description: Directions fit on one substrate's captures (q8 or bf16 teacher-forced), evaluated on the other's: cycle q8->bf16 best L18 AUROC 0.995, loop q8->bf16 best L2 0.985; within-substrate pooled and direction cosines included. K5 does not fire for cycle/loop. Muse has no cross reading (bf16 muse onsets < 10) — untested.
caveats: Cross AUROCs are honest (disjoint fit/eval); within numbers are pooled (fit+eval same data). Muse-K5 untestable until bf16 muse material exists.
